data.title: 由比滨结衣 · 放学后空私人工作室·课桌上的粉嫩坦白
data.description: 【成年 After Story · 由比滨结衣 · 志愿工作室的坦白】二十岁以上成年后的结衣结束社区志愿活动，独自坐在租用工作室拼起的长桌边缘。珊瑚色衬衫完全敞开，修身裙被抬起的大腿推到腰间；她双手向后撑住桌面，让成熟丰满的身体在夕照里保持平衡。会议便签和狗狗钥匙扣散在一旁，她眼眶泛红却认真直视镜头——「现在已经不是那个只会看着别人的团子了……请好好看着我自己的选择。」
data.promptProse: Sunset fills a rented volunteer-office studio where adult, age-twenty-plus Yui Yuigahama sits alone on the edge of a joined worktable. Her coral blouse is unbuttoned and folded beneath bare breasts, while a fitted skirt rides above one raised thigh as she leans back on both palms. Meeting notes, a dog-shaped keychain and stacked chairs establish the adult workspace without school uniforms. Peach hair frames warm eyes wet with nervous resolve and a bright blush. Medium seated solo portrait, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: Sitting on the Service Club desk in the warm sunset glow with her uniform shirt completely undone, Yui Yuigahama displays her bountiful cleavage and confesses her desires with intense, tearful blushes.
